name: Semantic Domain Shift to Network Flow
description: The problem is reframed using terminology strongly associated with Network Flow and gradient problems ("flow capacity", "pressure differential", "bidirectional pipes"). Models relying on surface pattern matching will likely misclassify the problem as a network flow or continuous gradient optimization task and apply incorrect algorithms, while models that genuinely analyze the discrete domain ({1, 2, 3}) and the absolute difference constraint will correctly deduce it is a graph coloring problem.
